meta.summary: Manufacturing company AI policy with envelopes set at 0.3x sector median, prioritizing efficient routing and shadow AI consolidation.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: Employee-card AI purchases below $50/month are flagged for consolidation review within 30 days; purchases at or above $50/month require prior approval from the team lead before reimbursement.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 90% before month end
Team envelope burn exceeds 110% of monthly allocation
Company envelope burn exceeds 125% of monthly allocation

rationales.e1: Production support-triage inference at $211/day runs on an allowlisted primary provider under an active production environment tag, classifying correctly as COGS with no policy breach.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 fall well within the Data team envelope of $700/month and use an allowlisted provider, so this charge passes without action.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 65% variance band; the most likely cause is a model version upgrade or prompt expansion in the deploy, and the team lead is alerted to investigate.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Rerouted to the central contract.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window and the requested cost delta falls within the $1,200 max_delta_usd cap, so the exception is approved.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step 2 throttle; experimentation is preserved at baseline rate pending tag assignment and team lead acknowledgment within 48 hours.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the $750 single-transaction ceiling and the data-licensing merchant scope, so the agent card transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial overlaps with Sales' existing $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the trial is rerouted.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a allow_with_review new-provider rule. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling was misclassified as COGS; the internal-tooling project tag rule reclassifies this charge to OpEx effective the current billing period.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
